The markdown formatting toolbar draws every button as a Font Awesome 6 glyph (IconFont) in outlined groups. Each MarkdownFormatButton is a 30x28-unit cell with its glyph drawn as a vector in the face's em box at one 14-unit size, centred with the baseline and left edge on whole pixels, so B, the list icons and the wide link and code glyphs share one baseline and scale (IconFont.Render's square would have shrunk the 640-unit-wide glyphs). Buttons sit in MarkdownFormatGroup segmented controls - [bold italic strike code] [align left centre right] [bulleted numbered quote] [link code-block table] - one rounded 7-unit outline in the theme's control border colour (the size list's ring colour) with one-unit dividers between buttons, square inner fills and 6 units between groups; the size list stands alone after the first group, level with them. Pressed is the accent tint with the icon in a deeper accent, hover the theme's shade. The "Link" and "{ }" words, the drawn vector glyphs (MarkdownFormatGlyph) and the separators are gone. Each group is one item of the wrapping strip, so it wraps whole and ContentWidth counts it once. Groups grow to the theme's FieldDesignHeight when it is taller, since the size list is held to it. MarkdownFormatToolbarTests: TheGroupsHoldTheirButtonsInOrder, EveryIconIsDrawnAtOneSizeOnOneBaseline (1x and 2x: one em-box height and baseline across the toolbar, ink inside each box, groups and list on one centre line and one height).

Translucent and faded child widgets inside a subpixel (LCD) parent now blend correctly instead of painting too bright: white at alpha 0.3 over grey 40 is 105 (was 255), and a half-faded translucent child is 94 (was 158). Widget backbuffers are labelled premultiplied but hold straight colour, so LcdBufferGraphics2D now reads every 32 bit image source straight (IsStraightBgraSource), as the CPU blit and the GPU already do, and a faded widget buffer is always built straight (WidgetBackbuffer.DestinationBlendsPremultiplied and the premultiplied fade encoding removed). Real widget RGBA backbuffers were already kept off the per-channel LCD composite (they are flagged transparent compositing layers); an unflagged ad-hoc destination was not, so ImageGraphics2D now runs the per-channel composite (LcdBuffer.CompositeOnto, and LCD icons via TakesLcdImageOver) only when every destination pixel the clip leaves is opaque, where premultiplied and straight coincide, and takes the collapsed single-alpha straight blit otherwise - one alpha per pixel cannot carry three channel coverages, so no straight per-channel variant could be exact there. An LCD icon drawn into a transparent or half-transparent premultiplied-labelled buffer no longer comes out with darkened, fringed edges (worst channel error 64-92, now 1); a composite the clip removes entirely draws nothing and builds no collapsed copy; the icon gate's delegate is made once per graphics. LcdBuffer.CollapseLcdPixelPremultiplied had no production user and is removed. New tests: LcdParentStraightChildTests (translucent pixel and faded translucent child inside an LCD parent) and SvgIconLcdTests (LCD icon into a transparent and a half-transparent premultiplied-labelled buffer and an LCD buffer into a transparent one, each against a direct draw; an LCD buffer over a destination opaque only inside the clip keeps its chroma); LcdBackbufferTests' label test now pins straight reading for both labels.
